A.notes: The dark console/SaaS direction is clear and the product demo is readable, but the idea does not extend far beyond a polished default dev-tools pattern. The scroll frames suggest mostly generic reveal motion, and the regular full-page/mobile captures show large blank stretches or hidden sections that materially hurt craft even though the automated accessibility and reduced-motion checks pass.

B.notes: The 'on-call edition' concept is strong and fully carried through: editorial layout, serif-plus-mono typography, and the singled-out log line all reinforce the brief. The scroll-strip shows a story progression that explains the product rather than decorating it, and the measured checks are clean; only some dense, tiny text on mobile keeps craft/access from a perfect score.

raw.why: B has a much clearer and more original concept, stronger typography, and motion that directly explains the product instead of mostly revealing sections.
